name: Swearing Falsely
overview: Scripture clearly condemns swearing falsely, emphasizing that lying to a neighbor or falsely testifying is a sin against the LORD, as seen in Leviticus 6:2-3 and Deuteronomy 19:16,18. God commands His people not to profane His name by swearing falsely (Leviticus 19:12) and requires that vows made to Him be honored faithfully (Numbers 30:2). These passages reveal the gravity of false oaths and false witness, highlighting their destructive impact on both individuals and the community under God's righteous judgment.
